title: Distribution depot performance, last financial year
bodyMd: The table lists the eight distribution depots a retailer operated last financial year. "Orders handled" is the number of customer orders the depot despatched, in thousands. "Cost per order" is the depot's total handling cost divided by the number of orders it handled. The columns may be sorted in any order.

data.caption: Eight distribution depots, with orders handled, on-time despatch rate, cost per order and customer return rate for the last financial year.

accessibilityText: A sortable table of eight distribution depots with four measures each: orders handled in thousands, percentage of orders despatched on time, cost per order in euros, and percentage of orders returned by the customer. Aldwich: 412 thousand orders, 91.2 percent on time, 3.85 euros per order, 4.1 percent returned. Brentmoor: 268 thousand, 96.5 percent, 4.40 euros, 2.8 percent. Corvin: 530 thousand, 88.4 percent, 3.20 euros, 5.6 percent. Dunsley: 175 thousand, 97.9 percent, 5.10 euros, 2.2 percent. Eastmere: 349 thousand, 93.6 percent, 4.05 euros, 3.4 percent. Fenwick: 206 thousand, 90.1 percent, 4.75 euros, 6.2 percent. Garrow: 488 thousand, 94.8 percent, 3.55 euros, 3.9 percent. Holt: 313 thousand, 85.7 percent, 4.25 euros, 4.8 percent.

provenance.notes: Original table. Depot names and every figure were invented for this exercise. The order counts and unit costs were chosen so that the depot with the largest total handling cost is neither the depot handling the most orders nor the depot with the highest cost per order, and so that the intended threshold count resolves unambiguously.
